channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Teen cannabis use linked to slower cognitive development
item.description: Adolescents who use cannabis may see slower growth in memory, attention, language, and processing speed, though abilities often develop normally otherwise.

item.title: Sunlight produces quantum entanglement without lasers
item.description: Researchers have achieved quantum entanglement using sunlight, offering a potential low-energy alternative to the lasers typically required for such processes.

item.title: New autism therapy shows benefits even in adult mice
item.description: Blocking the glycine transporter SLC6A20 restored key brain signaling and improved social, communication, and repetitive behaviors in autism-related models.

item.title: Scientists tracked 12 people in Antarctica for 10 months—what happened could shape future Mars missions
item.description: A ten-month Antarctic study found that astronauts may face challenges not only from isolation but also from constant proximity to the same people.
